outcome: Number of CD3+ and CD8+ decidual lymphocytes in placental bed
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing Cesarean section (30 with preeclampsia, 20 healthy controls)
finding: Women with preeclampsia had a significantly higher number of CD3+ and CD8+ T lymphocytes in the placental bed compared to healthy controls, suggesting a role for immune dysregulation in preeclampsia.
